qualification.reason: The document is an Expression of Interest (EOI) issued by OhioMHAS for Recovery Month Events funding. It includes a clear statement of purpose, eligibility requirements, funding details, and submission deadlines, indicating a procurement solicitation process.

quotes.quote: Recovery Month Events – Expression of Interest (EOI)
Request for Applications Due Date: 07/25/2025, by 3 p.m. EDT
OhioMHAS utilizes the EOI to conduct market research to identify organizations interested in participating in a proposed opportunity.

OhioMHAS is requesting expressions of interest from potential prevention, treatment, and/or recovery supports providers; community coalitions; recovery community organizations; peer run organizations; housing providers; faith-based organizations; schools; and other non-profit community organizations.
This opportunity will provide up to $10,000 for the following activities:

findings.title: Recovery Events funding opportunity up to $10,000
findings.fact: OhioMHAS is seeking eligible organizations to host activities/events raising awareness about recovery, with each eligible organization able to request up to $10,000.
findings.business_implication: The bidder can design a one-time event or project within a $10,000 budget focused on substance use recovery awareness.
findings.action_recommendation: Align the proposed project with the listed allowable activities and focus populations.

quotes.quote: Each eligible organization may request up to $10,000 to plan and implement activities and event(s) focused on any or all the following:
This opportunity will provide up to $10,000 for the following activities:

findings.title: 501(c)(3) and FTID required
findings.fact: Organizations must be 501(c)(3) non-profits with a federal tax identification number, and each FTID may submit only one request for up to $10,000.
findings.business_implication: Organizations without 501(c)(3) status or an FTID cannot apply; multiple sites under one FTID must submit a single request.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify 501(c)(3) status and FTID before submitting; coordinate any multi-site submission under one FTID.

quotes.quote: Organization must be 501(c)(3) non-profit.
An organization at the federal tax identification (FTID) number level, independent of number of sites, is eligible to submit a single request for up to $10,000.

findings.title: Microsoft Form submission required
findings.fact: Applicants must complete and submit the 'Request for Funding Form' via the provided Microsoft Forms link by July 25, 2025 at 3:00 p.m. EDT.
findings.business_implication: No alternative submission method is described; submissions must be made through the linked form by the stated deadline.
findings.action_recommendation: Complete the Microsoft Form well in advance of the deadline and retain confirmation of submission.

quotes.quote: To submit your expression of interest please complete all questions on the Microsoft form at https://forms.office.com/g/2YnKfqHta7 by July 25th at 3:00 p.m.
Please complete and submit the "Request for Funding Form" using the following link: https://forms.office.com/g/2YnKfqHta7
Request for Applications Due Date: 07/25/2025, by 3 p.m. EDT

findings.title: Solicitation and performance deadlines
findings.fact: The EOI was issued 07/11/2025; a technical assistance call was held on 07/18/2025; applications are due 07/25/2025; funds must be fully expended by 09/29/2025; and completed surveys are due by 11/07/2025.
findings.business_implication: The timeline is compressed, leaving limited time to plan and execute funded events after award.
findings.action_recommendation: Prepare a project timeline that ensures all spending is completed by September 29, 2025, and reporting by November 7, 2025.

quotes.quote: Request for Applications Posting Date: 07/11/2025
All awards must be fully expended by September 29, 2025.
Completed surveys are due no later than November 7, 2025.

findings.title: Funding is first-come, first-served
findings.fact: Funding will be provided to organizations on a first-come, first-served basis; no scoring or evaluation criteria are specified in the document.
findings.business_implication: Success depends on speed of submission rather than proposal quality, so early submission is critical.
findings.action_recommendation: Submit the form as early as possible after confirming eligibility and budget compliance.

quotes.quote: Funding will be provided to organizations on a first-come, first-served basis.

findings.title: Allowable costs and unallowable expenses
findings.fact: Funds may support event-related costs such as personnel, training, materials, and rent, but the event must be one-time only and cannot support ongoing services/salaries; food and entertainment (e.g., musicians, dunk tanks, giveaways) are expressly unallowable.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must carefully tailor the budget to allowable costs and avoid expressly prohibited items, or costs may be disallowed.
findings.action_recommendation: Review the full SOS 3.0 Allowable and Unallowable Expenses list referenced in the document before submitting a budget.

quotes.quote: The event (s) awarded under this funding opportunity will be viewed as one-time only and should not support ongoing services/supports/salaries.
Food
Entertainment expenses (e.g., musicians, dunk tanks, giveaways, etc.)
This is not an exhaustive list. Please see the full list of unallowable expenses for SOS funding at SOS 3.0 Allowable and Unallowable Expenses.

findings.title: Pass-through disbursement and outcomes reporting
findings.fact: Awarded funds will be disbursed via pass-through agent OhioPro; organizations must meet disbursement requirements to access funds and must complete an OhioMHAS outcomes survey due by November 7, 2025.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must be prepared to comply with OhioPro disbursement procedures and post-event reporting obligations.
findings.action_recommendation: Clarify OhioPro enrollment and disbursement requirements and plan for outcomes data collection from the outset.

quotes.quote: Organizations will be able to access the full amount of awarded funds once disbursement requirements are met. Awarded funds will be disbursed, via pass through agent, OhioPro.
Organizations are required to report to OhioMHAS how funds were utilized using the OhioMHAS outcomes survey.

findings.title: EOI screening language conflicts with direct award language
findings.fact: The document describes the EOI as a market-research/screening tool and states that no award will be issued unless indicated below, but later states that funding will be provided on a first-come, first-served basis and asks applicants to submit a 'Request for Funding Form'.
findings.business_implication: A bidder cannot clearly determine whether submission is a binding application for funding or merely an expression of interest in a possible future solicitation.
findings.action_recommendation: Seek clarification from OhioMHAS at peerservices@mha.ohio.gov before submitting.

quotes.quote: Unless indicated below, no award or funding will be issued as a result of this EOI.
Funding will be provided to organizations on a first-come, first-served basis.
Please complete and submit the "Request for Funding Form" using the following link: https://forms.office.com/g/2YnKfqHta7

findings.title: Liability, indemnity, and termination terms not specified
findings.fact: Unable to determine from the available document evidence.
findings.business_implication: The bidder cannot assess financial/legal exposure or termination rights because no contract terms are provided in the available pages.
findings.action_recommendation: Request full terms and conditions or a sample agreement from OhioMHAS before committing resources.
